correctness.rationale: Two independent Desargues graph models enumerate 60 perfect matchings, all 30 edge-extension counts 20 and all compatible pair-extension counts 4,6,8,10. Inclusion-expansion gives W congruent to 4 modulo 8 at all signings. Eleven-dimensional gauge quotient is exhaustive; independent signed-permanent and integer Walsh transform establish all 2048 multipliers, full spectrum, gap 4; exact reciprocal Hadamard inversion gives 557056/(60*2048)=68/15 and 1343 inverse coefficients. Standalone verifier passed.
